## Checklist

- [ ] Tests prove the changed behavior and relevant regression cases.
- [ ] Public API XML docs and developer documentation are updated.
- [ ] API, binary-format, and ndstool compatibility were considered.
- [ ] Bounds, untrusted-input, and output-path safety were considered.
- [ ] The changelog is updated when behavior is user-visible.
- [ ] No ROMs, keys, proprietary assets, or absolute local paths are included.
- [ ] Material AI assistance is disclosed.
